description: Returns the review block for one ASIN: overall star rating, total rating count, Amazon's 'customers say' AI summary, and the individual review list. Price: $0.003 per call. Same 404-billed / 503-not-billed semantics as product_details. Takes no filters: it returns the rating, rating count, the 'customers say' summary and the reviews Amazon shows on the product page itself. There is no paging, star filter or sort, and no full review history. For per-star counts read the rating histogram on product_details.

asin.description: Single Amazon ASIN, 10 uppercase alphanumeric characters.
asin.title: Asin

max_reviews.description: Cap on individual reviews returned (0 = all). The rating summary and customers_say are always returned; _reviews_total says how many exist.
max_reviews.title: Max Reviews

name: product_reviews
title: Customer reviews for a single ASIN
